purpose: Hand-written release-equivalent checks for the native credential-vault add-on used by School mode.

checks.evidence: The packaging path runs electron-builder install-app-deps for win32 x64.
The exact win-unpacked directory is removed before Electron packaging so stale native binaries cannot satisfy the probe.
Loads keytar from app.asar.unpacked and checks the vault API.
Writes school-mode-provenance.json into win-unpacked before the packaged probe, which reads and compares product, app id, package version and candidate commit.
Binds the probe service to package version and candidate commit, writes and reads an ephemeral value, deletes it, then requires post-delete absence.
Candidate commit and package version are passed into the packaged probe and release identity.
